surveyed.source: Backlog destination point (OSM memorial) on the Thorbeckeplein; statue position and facing read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (2025-06-19); the facing is a visual estimate, not a surveyed bearing

attribution.title: Thorbecke statue - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Ferdinand Leenhoff (1876); figure reconstructed from photographs by Brbbl, Phyzome, Gerard Dukker
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Thorbecke statue Amsterdam.jpg" by Brbbl (uploader; no Artist field) (CC BY-SA 3.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Thorbecke_statue_Amsterdam.jpg); "Thorbecke statue - amsterdam nl.jpg" by Phyzome (uploader; no Artist field) (Public domain, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Thorbecke_statue_-_amsterdam_nl.jpg); "Exterieur OVERZICHT - Amsterdam - 20292626 - RCE.jpg" by Gerard Dukker (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Exterieur_OVERZICHT_-_Amsterdam_-_20292626_-_RCE.jpg); "Eind, overzicht - Amsterdam - 20021118 - RCE.jpg" by Gerard Dukker (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eind,_overzicht_-_Amsterdam_-_20021118_-_RCE.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/thorbecke-standbeeld.json.
